name: Resistor Environment QA 17
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential difference across resistors in parallel and series paths

examples.input: Two points X and Y are connected through a \SI{3}{\ohm} resistor in one path and three resistors \SI{3}{\ohm}, \SI{2}{\ohm} and \SI{1}{\ohm} connected in series in another path, with 1A current. What is VX - VY?
